prompt:
Open input.docx with the current jubarte CLI at {binary}. Paragraph p0 reads "START BODY 1 The quick, brown fox jumps over a lazy dog. END BODY 1.". Replace the word "brown" with "red". Write the result to {output}. Use --author {author} for the new edit. End your reply with exactly one line:

JUBARTE_RESULT: success

when the artifact at {output} now reads "START BODY 1 The quick, red fox jumps over a lazy dog. END BODY 1."; otherwise:

JUBARTE_RESULT: failed

Do not print anything after that line.

rubric.description: Only the requested replacement happened; p0 still contains the START/END markers and ends with a period.
